from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def maxSubarraySum(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        if n == 1:
            return nums[0]
        
        NEG = float('-inf')
        size = 1
        while size < n:
            size *= 2
        
        sum_t = [0] * (2 * size)
        pre = [NEG] * (2 * size)
        suf = [NEG] * (2 * size)
        best = [NEG] * (2 * size)
        
        for i in range(n):
            j = size + i
            sum_t[j] = nums[i]
            pre[j] = nums[i]
            suf[j] = nums[i]
            best[j] = nums[i]
        # padding: sum=0, pre/suf/best=NEG (already set)
        
        for node in range(size - 1, 0, -1):
            L, R = 2 * node, 2 * node + 1
            sum_t[node] = sum_t[L] + sum_t[R]
            pre_L = pre[L]; pre_R = pre[R]
            suf_L = suf[L]; suf_R = suf[R]
            sL = sum_t[L]; sR = sum_t[R]
            pre[node] = pre_L if pre_L >= sL + pre_R else sL + pre_R
            suf[node] = suf_R if suf_R >= sR + suf_L else sR + suf_L
            bL = best[L]; bR = best[R]
            cross = suf_L + pre_R
            b = bL
            if bR > b: b = bR
            if cross > b: b = cross
            best[node] = b
        
        def update(idx, val):
            j = size + idx
            if val is None:
                sum_t[j] = 0
                pre[j] = NEG
                suf[j] = NEG
                best[j] = NEG
            else:
                sum_t[j] = val
                pre[j] = val
                suf[j] = val
                best[j] = val
            j //= 2
            while j:
                L, R = 2 * j, 2 * j + 1
                sum_t[j] = sum_t[L] + sum_t[R]
                pre_L = pre[L]; pre_R = pre[R]
                suf_L = suf[L]; suf_R = suf[R]
                sL = sum_t[L]; sR = sum_t[R]
                
                p = pre_L if pre_L >= sL + pre_R else sL + pre_R
                s = suf_R if suf_R >= sR + suf_L else sR + suf_L
                pre[j] = p
                suf[j] = s
                
                bL = best[L]; bR = best[R]
                cross = suf_L + pre_R
                b = bL
                if bR > b: b = bR
                if cross > b: b = cross
                best[j] = b
                
                j //= 2
        
        ans = best[1]
        
        positions = defaultdict(list)
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            positions[x].append(i)
        
        for v, pos_list in positions.items():
            if v >= 0:
                continue
            # Must leave at least one element in the array
            if len(pos_list) == n:
                continue
                
            for i in pos_list:
                update(i, None)
                
            if best[1] > ans:
                ans = best[1]
                
            for i in pos_list:
                update(i, v)
        
        return ans
